mechanism: workspace sparse ext4 image mounted by user-mode fuse2fs
result: 7 tests passed; 32 MiB concurrent writers received ENOSPC, image allocated blocks remained within image size, open-unlinked allocation, sparse file, links, truncate, mmap, oversized fallocate, daemon termination and normal cleanup exercised. A 100 GiB sparse image mounted and accepted a 1 MiB write with less than 1 GiB physical allocation. In a 32 MiB sandbox, backing image and daemon proc path were unavailable; a host-daemon SIGSTOP attempt was denied; root writes were denied and tmp and private home writes landed in scratch.

limits: 100 GiB image was not filled to capacity; ENOSPC was tested at 32 MiB. Reference acquisition and aggregate across other processes are not included.
